title: Compare multiple predictive models using cross-validation

objective: Practice model selection, resampling with explicit acceptance criteria and a reproducible result.

expected_output: Describe the metric, split strategy and leakage controls. A lower score is only meaningful for a stated objective.
acceptance_criteria: The submission addresses the task and all required core concepts.
Expected behavior and an edge case are described and checked.
Input assumptions, missing-value handling and output shape are documented where relevant.
Code is readable, uses appropriate R constructs and avoids destructive/external side effects.
Any result derived from statistics includes assumptions and relevant limitations.
hints: Identify the input, output and key R concept: Model selection, resampling.
Describe the metric, split strategy and leakage controls. A lower score is only meaningful for a stated objective.
Test a normal case, a boundary/failure case, and verify the output independently.
